mutations.note: The other half of blocker 2. It was `background: transparent` until :hover, so the one control that answers "the pane is too narrow" announced itself only to a reader who already knew where to put the pointer -- an affordance that is invisible is not an affordance. The sibling `::after` grip mark is pinned by the check named beside this one; this entry is the seam itself, because the two are separate declarations and reverting either alone is silent.
